Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh (error_streak_alert) as ${EXTRA_USAGE_ERROR_STREAK:-}, default 3: this many status=error polls in a row raise extra-usage-errors-<label> once per UTC day. 0 or a non-integer falls back to 3 and the rejected value is logged. BH-3985.

Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh (flat_accounts) as ${EXTRA_USAGE_FLAT_MIN_USD:-}, default 5: a meter flat for 12h while in overage the whole time (in_overage=1; inside the weekly credits a still meter is normal) alerts (extra-usage-flat-<label>, once per UTC day) only when the account's priced cost rows over those 12h are more than this many dollars (strict >). A non-integer falls back to 5 and the rejected value is logged. BH-3985.

Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh as ${EXTRA_USAGE_LOGINS:-}. Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh (stale_alert) as ${EXTRA_USAGE_STALE_HOURS:-}, default 2: a login with no meter reading for this many hours raises extra-usage-meter-<label> once per outage; the first ok poll re-arms it. 0 or a non-integer falls back to 2. BH-9068 (was 6, once per UTC day).
Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh as ${EXTRA_USAGE_TRACK:-1}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh (xcheck_accounts) as ${EXTRA_USAGE_XCHECK_GAP_PCT:-}, default 10: percent gap between the vendor meter delta and cost_rows dollars above which account-usage-gap-<label> fires (strict >). A non-integer falls back to 10 and the rejected value is logged. BH-1915 (BH-167.2).

Read by bin/extra-usage-track.sh (xcheck_accounts) as ${EXTRA_USAGE_XCHECK_MIN_USD:-}, default 1: a window whose meter delta is under this many dollars is neither fired nor cleared. A non-integer falls back to 1 and the rejected value is logged. BH-1915 (BH-167.2).
